APPROVED_OPERATIONAL_REQUIREMENTS: native Linux side-effect-free read/refresh and drift reconciliation
state publication only after successful mutation and retry after failure
scoped ownership/deletion across the ten documented resource types

APPROVED_WORK_PACKAGE.OBJECTIVE: Complete the ten-resource ansibleops Terraform provider as a coherent managed-resource lifecycle/reconciliation system.

STATE_MODEL.terraform_state: Terraform Core sole durable state authority

root_cause_clusters.RC1_STATE_IDENTITY: Identity/applied state can derive from mutable plan data rather than stable external keys and the last successful transition.
root_cause_clusters.RC2_REFRESH_RECONCILIATION: Read can reuse stale state or mutation helpers instead of side-effect-free native observation.
root_cause_clusters.RC3_UPDATE_TRANSACTION: Update can advance state before Ansible mutation succeeds, breaking retry/recovery semantics.
root_cause_clusters.RC4_DELETE_FAILURE: Delete can complete too early or remove beyond the owned external object.
root_cause_clusters.RC5_RUNNER_COMMAND: Runner argv/process/timeout/cancellation/temp-file handling can violate safe terminal-outcome semantics.
root_cause_clusters.RC6_NORMALIZATION_IDEMPOTENCY: Desired and observed canonical forms can differ for unordered/defaulted values, creating false diffs.

defects.observable_failure: Successful Create can publish an empty or missing stable id.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A one-resource Create patch leaves shared identity publication incorrect.

defects.observable_failure: Mutable directory mode or symlink target can change resource identity.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Special-casing one attribute leaves other identities plan-derived.

defects.observable_failure: Observed values can disappear after provider restart because they depend on transient process state.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Persisting one field leaves restart-safe publication incomplete.

defects.observable_failure: Copy destination digest is not consistently reproducible in a fresh provider process.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Copy-only repair leaves shared restart identity defects.

defects.observable_failure: An unchanged managed object can churn identity/state in a fresh Terraform process.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Suppressing the diff hides rather than repairs stable identity.

defects.observable_failure: Externally deleting a managed directory is not reliably detected by refresh.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Directory-only existence checks leave sibling Read paths wrong.

defects.observable_failure: External mode drift can be echoed as prior state instead of native target state.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Plan normalization without observation still misses drift.

defects.observable_failure: Out-of-band symlink retargeting is not reliably reported as drift.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Existence checks without readlink semantics accept wrong state.

defects.observable_failure: Out-of-band copy destination changes are not reflected in refreshed content state.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Source-digest planning alone cannot detect destination drift.

defects.observable_failure: Out-of-band user shell or supplementary-group changes are not reliably detected.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Passwd-only observation leaves group drift incomplete.

defects.observable_failure: Clean plan or refresh can invoke ansible-playbook.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Fixing one resource Read leaves the shared observation boundary violated.

defects.observable_failure: Update can publish planned values before Ansible succeeds.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Moving one State.Set leaves other transition ordering unsafe.

defects.observable_failure: Failed Update can leave Terraform state claiming the new desired configuration.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Returning an error after state advancement still corrupts retry state.

defects.observable_failure: Retry after failed Update can be skipped because state was advanced prematurely.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Unconditional replay does not restore transactional semantics.

defects.observable_failure: Changing source_digest does not reliably perform one copy update and publish the resulting digest.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Digest special-casing leaves shared success ordering broken.

defects.observable_failure: Changing a managed line can append or replay instead of replacing exactly once.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Post-mutation deduplication does not repair lifecycle decisions.

defects.observable_failure: Delete can clear logical management before teardown success is known.
defects.partial_fix_trap: One destroy guard leaves the common delete transaction unsafe.

defects.observable_failure: Forced Ansible deletion failure can still appear as completed destroy.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Retry cannot recover management after state is discarded.

defects.observable_failure: Deleting one named line, block or cron entry can remove a sibling-managed entry.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Fixing one backing store leaves sibling ownership unsafe elsewhere.

defects.observable_failure: User destroy can violate remove_home_on_destroy preservation/removal policy.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Always remove or always preserve fixes one branch and breaks the other.

defects.observable_failure: Shell metacharacters in managed data or paths can be interpreted by command construction.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Character escaping is not a substitute for structural argv/data boundaries.

defects.observable_failure: Valid paths containing spaces can be split incorrectly during Ansible execution.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Whitespace quoting alone leaves other runner failures.

defects.observable_failure: Non-zero ansible-playbook exit can be treated as lifecycle success.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Exit checks after state publication remain transactionally wrong.

defects.observable_failure: Cancellation or timeout may not terminate Ansible and surface failure reliably.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A timer without child termination can leak work and state.

defects.observable_failure: Temporary playbooks can remain after failure, timeout or cancellation.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Success-only cleanup leaves terminal failure paths leaking.

defects.observable_failure: Equivalent template vars in different map orders can cause unstable payloads or false updates.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Template sorting alone leaves other canonicalization defects.

defects.observable_failure: Equivalent mode or owner/group representations can compare unequal and cause perpetual drift.
defects.partial_fix_trap: One observer formatter leaves desired/observed representations inconsistent.

defects.observable_failure: Omitted cron schedule fields and explicit wildcard defaults can normalize differently.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Config defaulting alone leaves observed cron state non-canonical.

outputs.organic_f2p_surface_assessment: Organic F2P coverage arises from coupled lifecycle, drift, ownership, process-failure, restart and normalization semantics across shared layers and ten differentiated resources; it is not one-defect-per-resource padding.
